name: Fadal
description: Fadal is a MUDA-approved plotted development at Shyadanahalli, where buyers build their own homes. Forty-four plots sit on 11,736 sq m — just under three acres — with a tenth of the site given to park and nine-metre roads throughout. The layout is Vaastu and Feng Shui compliant.

contentWarnings: Specifications omitted. The live page lists interior finishes — imported marble, wooden flooring to bedrooms, engineered wooden doors, floor-to-ceiling glass — on a development that sells bare land. It also refers to 'partial villas'. This is another project's content and is not carried over.
The live page duplicates its 'Electrical' specification group.
The live page shows an empty Amenities section. The amenities here are taken from the brief, sourced from the old WordPress page.
Fadal ranks in search on the old WordPress URL. That page carries Happiness 2's villa floor plans under a 'Master Plan' heading. The redirect matters (§13).

Plot count corrected from 43 to 44 against the approved MUDA layout (Authority Resolution 97, 07-03-2020). Net extent 11,735.90 sq m; land use 54.60% residential, 30.36% roads, 10.03% park, 5.01% civic amenities.
Eight plots are irregular ("9.0 × Odd" on the approved drawing) and have no single stated dimension. They are counted but not sized.
Location label still reads KRS Main Road, which the client's own copy uses; the approved layout places the site at Shyadanahalli, Kasaba Hobli. Confirm which the filter should show.
